# Theme gallery

Set `general.theme` to one of the built-in names, or to the path of a CSS
file. See [Theming](../README.md#theming) for the variables and classes.

## gtk, under a dark GTK theme

```toml
[general]
theme = "gtk"
```

![gtk, under a dark GTK theme](themes/gtk-dark.png)

## gtk, under a light GTK theme

```toml
[general]
theme = "gtk"
```

![gtk, under a light GTK theme](themes/gtk-light.png)

## catppuccin-latte

```toml
[general]
theme = "catppuccin-latte"
```

![catppuccin-latte](themes/catppuccin-latte.png)

<details>
<summary><code>themes/catppuccin-latte.css</code></summary>

```css
/* Catppuccin Latte — https://catppuccin.com/palette */

window {
    --bg: #eff1f5;
    --fg: #4c4f69;
    --accent: #8839ef;
    --urgent: #df8e1d;
    --danger: #d20f39;

    --card-bg: #e6e9ef;
    --urgent-fg: #4c4f69;
}
```

</details>

## dark

<summary><code>themes/dark.css</code></summary>

    --bg: #222226;
    --fg: #ffffff;
    --accent: #3584e4;
    --urgent: #cd9309;
    --danger: #ff7b63;

    --accent-fg: #ffffff;

}
